+"""Load images without requesting user-provided URLs."""
+import base64
+from urllib.parse import unquote, urlsplit
+
+from app.core.config import settings
+from app.services.storage import storage
+
+
+def load_image(value: str) -> bytes | None:
+    if not value or not isinstance(value, str):
+        return None
+    try:
+        if value.startswith("data:image/"):
+            header, encoded = value.split(",", 1)
+            if not header.lower().endswith(";base64"):
+                return None
+            return base64.b64decode(encoded, validate=True)
+
+        # Storage URLs identify objects; they are never fetched over HTTP.
+        prefix = settings.STORAGE_HOST.rstrip("/") + "/"
+        if value.startswith(prefix):
+            if "?" in value or "#" in value:
+                return None
+            key = unquote(value[len(prefix):])
+        else:
+            parsed = urlsplit(value)
+            if parsed.scheme or parsed.netloc or parsed.query or parsed.fragment:
+                return None
+            key = value
+        if not key or key.startswith("/") or "\\" in key or any(
+            part in ("", ".", "..") for part in key.split("/")
+        ):
+            return None
+        return storage.download_image(key)
+    except Exception:
+        return None

+import base64
+import io
+import zipfile
+
+import pytest
+from PIL import Image
+from sqlmodel import Session
+
+from app.db.engine import engine
+from app.models import Episode, StoryCut
+from tests.conftest import signup
+
+
+def make_episode(client, paths):
+    headers = signup(client)
+    project = client.post('/api/v1/projects', headers=headers, json={'title': 'Test', 'genres': []}).json()
+    with Session(engine) as session:
+        episode = Episode(project_id=project['id'], title='Test', episode_order=1)
+        session.add(episode)
+        session.commit()
+        session.refresh(episode)
+        episode_id = str(episode.id)
+        for order, path in enumerate(paths, 1):
+            session.add(StoryCut(episode_id=episode.id, cut_order=order, script='', selected_layout='single', aspect_ratio='1:1', image_path=path))
+        session.commit()
+    return headers, episode_id
+
+
+def image_url():
+    buf = io.BytesIO()
+    Image.new('RGB', (1, 1)).save(buf, 'PNG')
+    return 'data:image/png;base64,' + base64.b64encode(buf.getvalue()).decode()
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('format', ['zip', 'webtoon'])
+def test_missing_cuts_reported(client, format):
+    headers, episode_id = make_episode(client, [None, image_url(), 'http://127.0.0.1/secret', 'missing/object', 'data:image/png;base64,YmFk'])
+    response = client.post(f'/api/v1/episodes/{episode_id}/export?format={format}', headers=headers)
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+    assert response.headers['X-Missing-Cuts'] == '1,3,4,5'
+    if format == 'zip':
+        with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(response.content)) as archive:
+            assert sorted(archive.namelist()) == ['Test_02.png', 'missing.txt']
+            assert archive.read('missing.txt') == b'1\n3\n4\n5\n'
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('format', ['zip', 'webtoon'])
+def test_complete_export_has_no_missing_report(client, format):
+    headers, episode_id = make_episode(client, [image_url()])
+    response = client.post(f'/api/v1/episodes/{episode_id}/export?format={format}', headers=headers)
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+    assert 'X-Missing-Cuts' not in response.headers
+    if format == 'zip':
+        with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(response.content)) as archive:
+            assert archive.namelist() == ['Test_01.png']
+
+
+def test_all_missing(client):
+    headers, episode_id = make_episode(client, [None, 'http://127.0.0.1/'])
+    response = client.post(f'/api/v1/episodes/{episode_id}/export?format=zip', headers=headers)
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+    assert response.headers['X-Missing-Cuts'] == '1,2'
+    with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(response.content)) as archive:
+        assert archive.namelist() == ['missing.txt']
+        assert archive.read('missing.txt') == b'1\n2\n'
+    response = client.post(f'/api/v1/episodes/{episode_id}/export?format=webtoon', headers=headers)

+import base64
+import io
+import zipfile
+
+import pytest
+import requests
+from PIL import Image
+from sqlmodel import Session
+
+from app.core.config import settings
+from app.db.engine import engine
+from app.models import Episode, StoryCut
+from app.services.ai.base import BaseAIService
+from app.services.image_loader import load_image
+from app.services.reference_board import download_image
+from app.services.storage import storage
+from tests.conftest import signup
+
+
+def png_bytes():
+    output = io.BytesIO()
+    Image.new("RGB", (1, 1), "red").save(output, format="PNG")
+    return output.getvalue()
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("value", [
+    "http://127.0.0.1/secret", "http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/",
+    "https://example.com/redirect", "//internal/secret",
+    settings.STORAGE_HOST + ".evil/secret", settings.STORAGE_HOST + "/../secret",
+    settings.STORAGE_HOST + "/%2e%2e/secret", "http://user@internal/secret",
+])
+def test_all_image_loaders_reject_arbitrary_urls(value, monkeypatch):
+    def forbidden(*args, **kwargs):
+        pytest.fail("unexpected network request")
+    monkeypatch.setattr(requests, "get", forbidden)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(storage, "download_image", forbidden)
+    assert load_image(value) is None
+    assert BaseAIService.__new__(BaseAIService)._download_image(value) is None
+    assert download_image(value) is None
+
+
+def test_storage_and_data_images_work():
+    image = png_bytes()
+    key = storage.upload_image(image, "test", "image")
+    data = "data:image/png;base64," + base64.b64encode(image).decode()
+    for value in (key, settings.STORAGE_HOST + "/" + key, data):
+        assert load_image(value) == image
+        assert BaseAIService.__new__(BaseAIService)._download_image(value) == image
+        assert download_image(value).size == (1, 1)
+
+
+def test_export_skips_untrusted_url_and_exports_storage_and_data(client, monkeypatch):
+    headers = signup(client)
+    project = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=headers, json={"title": "Test", "genres": []}).json()
+    image = png_bytes()
+    key = storage.upload_image(image, "test", "export")
+    with Session(engine) as session:
+        episode = Episode(project_id=project["id"], title="Test", episode_order=1)
+        session.add(episode)
+        session.commit()
+        session.refresh(episode)
+        episode_id = str(episode.id)
+        for order, path in enumerate(("http://127.0.0.1/secret", settings.STORAGE_HOST + "/" + key, "data:image/png;base64," + base64.b64encode(image).decode()), 1):
+            session.add(StoryCut(episode_id=episode.id, cut_order=order, script="", selected_layout="single", aspect_ratio="1:1", image_path=path))
+        session.commit()
+    def forbidden(*args, **kwargs):
+        pytest.fail("unexpected network request")
+    monkeypatch.setattr(requests, "get", forbidden)
+    result = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{episode_id}/export?format=zip", headers=headers)
+    assert result.status_code == 200, result.text
+    with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(result.content)) as archive:
+        assert sorted(archive.namelist()) == ["Test_02.png", "Test_03.png", "missing.txt"]
+        assert archive.read("missing.txt") == b"1\n"
+        assert all(archive.read(name) == image for name in ("Test_02.png", "Test_03.png"))
+    result = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{episode_id}/export?format=webtoon", headers=headers)
+    assert result.status_code == 200
+    assert Image.open(io.BytesIO(result.content)).size == (1, 52)
